authority: User explicitly redirected original PR #1 to alpha/terminal-wealth-first research and authorized structural changes to opportunity discovery, ownership, replacement and core alpha logic while preserving causal next-session execution and frozen evidence identities.

evidence.diagnosis: committed_offensive_core raises exposure and captures common-five leaders, but broad scopes collapse primarily because two intact incumbents cannot be displaced when stronger causal opportunities emerge. Decisive union/removal missed-winner windows were ~100% invested, so idle cash is not the main cause.
evidence.score_actionability: The unchanged control emitted causal LATCHED_LEADER_REPLACEMENT witnesses on 2025-06-30 and 2025-07-28 before subsequent high-PnL entrants in both broad scopes. This proves the existing score sometimes knows a stronger challenger before the committed owner can act.

economic_hypothesis: Keep the high-exposure, long-hold behavior that helped common-five, but permit a sparse one-way ownership handoff only after an incumbent's own causal alpha has decayed below the alpha level that justified its campaign and a currently eligible challenger exceeds that frozen campaign reference. This should release capital from stale incumbents without restoring periodic rotation.

treatment.base: Independent high-exposure cash-long core using the committed-offensive causal entry, security-break and vacancy-funding semantics; no account/market risk liquidation, volatility target, sector budget or recovery wait.
treatment.owned_alpha_reference: When a vacancy-fill decision first requests a symbol, record that close's causal Features.score. Bind that score to the campaign when actual inventory is first observed. This is an alpha reference, not price/cost basis and not a future label.
treatment.displacement: Only with a full intact book, broad market admission open, no security-specific break, and at least one currently eligible unheld challenger. Find the held name with the largest deterioration from its own owned_alpha_reference. It is displacement-eligible only when current score is below that own reference. The strongest eligible challenger must have current score strictly above that incumbent's frozen reference. Then request a full exit of only that incumbent.
treatment.one_way_campaign_rule: A voluntarily displaced symbol is retired from vacancy admission until its own security-specific trend campaign has broken. This prevents repeated same-campaign exit/re-entry feedback. A later fresh trend campaign may be admitted normally.
treatment.funding: Never spend expected sale proceeds. The exit close requests no replacement. Later closes may fill an actual vacancy using only observed cash and then-current eligibility/ranking; no challenger reservation survives the sale.
treatment.no_top_up_change: Do not fix the separate partial-fill/top-up attribution in this candidate; existing intact units remain unchanged so the screen isolates displacement.
treatment.execution: Unchanged close decision / next-session open, sells before buys, cash-only, long-only, no leverage or shorting, prior-volume liquidity, board lots, T+1, fees, slippage and price-limit handling.

structural_difference_from_rejected_work: Not leadership_handover/opportunity_reassignment: no scheduled review, score multiple, rank cutoff, confirmation-day threshold or risk-parent wrapper.
Not relative_campaign_owner or basis_failure_exit: no benchmark-relative lifecycle label, PnL/cost basis, future outcome, EMA threshold or campaign-quality gate.
Not offensive_core: no periodic full top-N reselection or equal-weight rebalance of intact winners.
Not committed_offensive_core: a full intact book can now release exactly one stale incumbent when a fresh challenger crosses its campaign-specific alpha reference.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Advance only if cross-scope wealth improvement is economically material, not common-five-only, and joint optical-leader removal retains actual alpha. Do not reject solely for MDD/order/turnover deterioration during discovery.
measurement.failure_rule: If the fixed three-scope wealth result does not materially improve the cross-scope objective, preserve it as failed and move to a substantively different alpha structure; do not search score multiples, decay margins, confirmation days, position counts or pool variants.

prohibitions: No future labels or future highs in decisions
